audio jack, 2.5 mm, 3.5 mm, 6.35 mm, 1/4 inch, minijack, jack, mono, stereo, balanced, trs, trrs, ctia, ahj, omtp, headphones, headset, microphone, tip, ring, sleeve, pinout, pins, connector, reference
Tip, ring, sleeve: from the plug\'s end back. The same on 2.5, 3.5 and 6.35 mm jacks.
The signal: an instrument, a speaker, a mono line
Mono, as a guitar cable has it. A TS plug in a stereo socket grounds its ring.
Balanced mono, as studio gear\'s 6.35 mm line ins and outs have it: wired as XLR\'s pins 2, 3 and 1
CTIA (also AHJ): most phones, laptops and headsets now
OMTP: older phones; the microphone and ground are swapped
